newsitem.title: USA: Toys R Us 8-week U.S.same-store sales flat.
newsitem.headline: Toys R Us 8-week U.S.same-store sales flat.

text.p: Toys R Us Inc said Monday that U.S. comparable store sales were flat for the full 1996 holiday selling season, although they increased 4 percent for the month of December.
The company also said that for the 8-week holiday selling season ended Dec 28 total sales rose 4 pecent, to $4.1 billion from $3.9 billion.
The company said that its year-to-date sales (11 months) rose 6 percent, to $9.3 billion from $8.8 billion last year.
Comparable store sales for that period increased 2 percent.

Internationally, for the holiday season, the company reported that Canadian stores had double digit comparable store sales increases, driven by marketing and customer services initiatives as well as the increase in the video business. In Japan, Spain and the United Kingdom, comparable store sales were flat to slightly higher for the season, while Germany and France experienced lower comparable store sales.

The company said the same-store sales were flat for the holiday selling season "despite the excitement generated in the bideo hardware business with the release of NBintendo 64 and the presence of some hot products such as Tickle Me Elmo."
Sales were hurt, it said, by the lack of software titles for the new video platforms and the lateness of Thanksgiving holiday.
